issues.description: Several operational recommendations (e.g., 'zapněte logování a auditní stopy tam, kde to lze', reference to reporting process at ai.vut.cz, and 'konzultujte IT a právní/GDPR oddělení') are appropriate but lack explicit inline citations to the relevant KB excerpts (institutional / repo / governance sections).
issues.required_fix: Add explicit citations to the relevant KB excerpts (e.g., institutional deployment, audit logging, repo documentation / 9.x appendices) next to these statements so each non‑trivial operational claim is directly supported by a provided excerpt.

issues.description: The bullet 'Dopad na akademickou integritu: dostupnost generativních nástrojů...' is currently unlabeled by a supporting KB citation even though related material exists elsewhere in the manual (chapters on academic integrity and assessment).
issues.required_fix: Add a citation to the relevant section(s) on academic integrity and assessment (e.g., chapter/section addressing academic integrity, redesign of assessment) to ground this claim.

issues.description: The LaTeX source uses explicit line breaks ('\\') inside itemize items (checklist), which is unnecessary and can cause formatting warnings or inconsistent spacing in LaTeX. Also some \emph{} markers are used inline which is acceptable but check consistency with document style.
issues.required_fix: Remove the trailing '\\' line breaks inside the itemize environment items (checklist). Ensure emphasis styling (\emph{}) follows the guide's typographic conventions.

issues.description: The 'Audit a záznamy' step and the 'Praktické příklady mitigace' items are high-level. They would benefit from one or two brief concrete examples of what to monitor during a pilot (e.g., types of incidents, basic metrics), but such examples must either be drawn from KB or clearly labeled as 'general background knowledge'.
issues.required_fix: Either (a) add concrete monitoring metrics/examples citing the repository/templates if available, or (b) add a short sentence clearly labeling suggested metrics as 'general background knowledge' and point readers to the repo for concrete templates.

issues.description: Checklist item asking 'Bude pilot monitorován a jaké metriky/incidenty hlásíme IT/GDPR týmu' references an online repo but does not point to a specific template or example. For pedagogical usability, include a pointer to the specific checklist/template in Přílohy or in the repo.
issues.required_fix: Add a parenthetical citation or explicit reference to the specific repo resource (e.g., Příloha number or repo path) that contains the monitoring/reporting templates.
